title: Talk, talk, talk
coreMove: Replace announcement with protected private labor until the work has earned the right to be seen.
sourcePressure: Aspire section: validation talk as false progress. Supported by frozen source sidecar.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating silence as secrecy or timidness instead of as a way to keep reward attached to actual work.

sourceAnchors.name: Isocrates
sourceAnchors.detail: The frozen opening bundle identifies Isocrates as an anchor for suspicion toward eager self-advertisement before substance exists.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Isocrates belongs as a quick pressure point: old teachers distrusted the student whose mouth outran the work.

sourceAnchors.name: Sherman
sourceAnchors.detail: The source sidecar uses Sherman as the cleaner anchor for privacy, severity, and doing the work rather than narrating it.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Sherman gives the lesson a harder edge: keep the work severe, private, and unadvertised until it has facts behind it.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person 'You' direct address, retrospective 'It took her three weeks to see', question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside only if source-supported, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference where source anchors allow it
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
